extraction.parser: hand-rolled Python html.parser tree builder (spec-build source: scratchpad htmlutil.py) - no regex table matching
guarantees: colspan expanded into phantom cells so every table row stays positionally aligned with its 8-column HL7 header (field | fieldName | dataType | usage | maxRpt | length | codeSet | guidance)
the leading empty-header numbering column of FHIR/CDA tables is PRESERVED as the parent/child hierarchy key
all tables on a page are kept (page 7766314 contributes 10 segment tables)
nested tables are handled by the tree parser - rows are attributed to their own table
<style> and <script> blocks stripped before text extraction
<a> tags unwrapped with no inserted whitespace; whitespace around / normalised in element paths
zero-width and bidi marks (U+200B..U+200F, U+FEFF, U+00AD, U+2060) stripped before OID matching

oidDetection.tokenRule: [0-2] followed by 4 or more dot-separated numeric arcs (>=5 arcs total), not preceded or followed by a word character or dot
exclusions: a candidate immediately preceded by the word 'section' is a cross-reference, not an OID (drops 2.2.3.6.4, 2.7.3.6.4)

counting.refCount: number of extracted statement units (one table cell line, or one body line) in which the OID appears
counting.note: refCount is dominated by value-set listing pages where a code-system OID repeats once per concept row (2.16.840.1.113883.6.8 alone accounts for 888 rows on page 23135664). pageCount is the more useful spread signal. Distinct (oid, page, distinct-quote) triples across the corpus: 911.

roleClassification.method: evidence-based, not prefix-based - each occurrence is scored for role signals and the dominant signal wins; the full tally is kept in roleEvidence

signals.cdaTemplateId: templateId near the OID, or “@root SHALL be set to '<oid>'” in a cell that says ‘Template indicator’
signals.codeSystem: @codeSystem='<oid>', ‘out of coding system <oid>’, or a ‘Code System Identifier’ column
signals.assigningAuthority: ‘Assigning Authority’ / ‘Registration Authority’ wording, or ‘the system sub-element SHALL contain the OID urn:oid:<oid>’

roleClassification.caution: The nphies sub-arcs are NOT single-purpose. 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.105.* and ...1.204.* each hold BOTH CDA templateIds AND code-system / value-set identifiers (e.g. ...1.105.2 is a codeSystem, ...1.204.15 is a codeSystem and ...1.204.15.1 its value set). Trust the per-OID role field, not the arc.

oidsDistinct.note: 353 distinct OIDs survive the >=5-arc rule across all 617 pages. The brief's ~207 is close to the 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.* subset only.

oidMentions.note: Raw statement-unit mentions. Excluding the five bulk value-set listing pages the figure falls into the brief's range; see oidDetection.counting.

fixedValues.note: Every record is gated on an actual SHALL / MUST / 'Fixed value' statement with the nearest preceding modal verb; MAY/SHOULD/SHALL NOT statements are excluded from the fixed-value set (SHALL NOT is recorded separately as statementType 'prohibited').

resourceTypes.note: 24 distinct resourceType SHALL-values; the extra five come from the radiology pages (Binary, DocumentReference, Endpoint, ImagingStudy, Procedure).

usageLegendSource.quote: R = required, R2 = required if known, O = optional, I = ignored

confidenceNotes: Every record carries a verbatim source.quote taken from the rendered Confluence body. No quote is synthesised.
Where the source page contradicts itself or the golden samples, the record keeps the verbatim spec text and adds a sourceAnomaly / warning field rather than silently correcting it.

quarantineRule: An OID is quarantined when EITHER (a) PATTERN: any single arc contains a run of 4 or more identical digits (e.g. 11111111111110, 10000000003875, 11000000002333), or the OID contains '123456', or it contains the well-known NPHIES sample organisation id fragment '15000000', or it sits under the reserved sample arc 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.999.99 ; OR (b) USAGE: every single occurrence of the OID in the whole 617-page corpus sits inside an explicit example marker ('Example:', 'Eg:', 'e.g.', 'In this example'). Rule (a) is high confidence; rule (b) alone is medium confidence because an OID can be normative and only ever illustrated by example. Both the rule that fired and the confidence are recorded per entry.
